# Verywell Mind

> Verywell Mind is a consumer mental health publication offering evidence-based articles on conditions, therapy, self-improvement, relationships, and psychological science.

Content is reviewed by medical and mental health professionals and organized around mental health conditions, treatment approaches, wellness habits, and practical coping strategies. The site also publishes explainers on psychology concepts, social behavior, and emotional wellbeing.

## Core Hubs
- [Mental Health A-Z](https://www.verywellmind.com/mental-health-a-z-4157271): Directory of mental health topics, conditions, symptoms, and treatments.
- [Conditions A-Z](https://www.verywellmind.com/conditions-a-z-4847395): Browse mental health and behavioral conditions by name.
- [Self-Improvement](https://www.verywellmind.com/self-improvement-4157210): Articles on habits, motivation, resilience, and personal growth.
- [Relationships](https://www.verywellmind.com/relationships-4157190): Guidance on romantic, family, social, and workplace relationships.
- [Psychology](https://www.verywellmind.com/psychology-4157187): Explanations of theories, concepts, experiments, and famous psychologists.
- [Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/therapy-4157224): Information about therapy types, techniques, and what to expect.
- [Living Well](https://www.verywellmind.com/living-well-4157214): Everyday mental wellness advice, stress relief, and healthy routines.
- [Crisis Support](https://www.verywellmind.com/crisis-support-7500576): Emergency and crisis mental health resources and support information.

## Mental Health Conditions
- [Depression](https://www.verywellmind.com/depression-4157261): Symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment information for depression.
- [Anxiety](https://www.verywellmind.com/anxiety-4157280): Guides to anxiety symptoms, disorders, coping, and treatment options.
- [Panic Disorder](https://www.verywellmind.com/panic-disorder-4157230): Information on panic attacks, diagnosis, and management strategies.
- [Social Anxiety Disorder](https://www.verywellmind.com/social-anxiety-disorder-4157229): Articles on social anxiety symptoms, triggers, and treatment.
- [PTSD](https://www.verywellmind.com/ptsd-4157227): Coverage of trauma, post-traumatic stress, and recovery approaches.
- [Bipolar Disorder](https://www.verywellmind.com/bipolar-disorder-4157235): Overview of bipolar symptoms, episodes, and treatment.
- [ADHD](https://www.verywellmind.com/adhd-4157234): Resources on attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder across ages.
- [OCD](https://www.verywellmind.com/ocd-4157231): Articles on obsessive-compulsive disorder symptoms and treatment.

## Therapy and Treatment
- [Types of Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/types-of-therapy-2795763): Overview of major psychotherapy approaches and how they differ.
- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-cognitive-behavior-therapy-2795747): Explains CBT principles, techniques, and common uses.
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/dialectical-behavior-therapy-1067402): Introduction to DBT skills, structure, and treatment goals.
- [Psychodynamic Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/psychodynamic-therapy-2795769): Summary of psychodynamic methods and underlying theory.
- [Group Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-group-therapy-2795760): What group therapy involves, benefits, and limitations.
- [Online Therapy](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-online-therapy-2795765): Guide to teletherapy formats, benefits, and considerations.
- [How to Find a Therapist](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-find-a-therapist-5112653): Practical steps for choosing and contacting a therapist.
- [What to Expect at Your First Therapy Session](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-to-expect-at-your-first-therapy-session-5188860): Introductory guide to beginning therapy.

## Medications and Substances
- [SSRIs](https://www.verywellmind.com/ssris-379675): Overview of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors and common uses.
- [Prozac for Panic Disorder](https://www.verywellmind.com/prozac-and-panic-disorder-2584181): Explains Prozac use, effects, and side effects for panic disorder.
- [Cymbalta for Panic Disorder](https://www.verywellmind.com/cymbalta-for-panic-disorder-2584273): Guide to Cymbalta for panic symptoms and treatment considerations.
- [Pristiq for Anxiety and Panic](https://www.verywellmind.com/faqs-about-pristiq-for-panic-disorder-2584361): Reviews timeline, side effects, and panic-related use.
- [5-HTP for Depression](https://www.verywellmind.com/5-htp-for-depression-1066521): Supplement overview, dosage considerations, and side effects.
- [Over-the-Counter Antidepressants](https://www.verywellmind.com/over-the-counter-antidepressants-1066678): Discusses nonprescription products marketed for depression support.
- [How Long Does Nicotine Stay in Your System?](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-long-does-nicotine-stay-in-your-system-80219): Timeline of nicotine metabolism, testing, and withdrawal factors.
- [How to Quit Nicotine Gum](https://www.verywellmind.com/addicted-to-nicotine-gum-now-what-2825031): Advice for tapering and stopping nicotine gum use.

## Self-Improvement and Emotional Health
- [How to Be More Patient](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-be-more-patient-5186953): Practical strategies for building patience in daily life.
- [How to Build Mental Strength](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-mental-strength-2795039): Explains mental strength habits and resilience-building practices.
- [How to Practice Self-Compassion](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-practice-self-compassion-4161142): Techniques for reducing self-criticism and increasing self-kindness.
- [What Is Emotional Intelligence?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-emotional-intelligence-2795423): Introduction to emotional intelligence and its core components.
- [Utilizing Emotional Intelligence in the Workplace](https://www.verywellmind.com/utilizing-emotional-intelligence-in-the-workplace-4164713): Applying EQ skills to communication, teamwork, and leadership.
- [How to Set Boundaries](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-set-boundaries-5208802): Guidance on creating and maintaining healthy personal limits.
- [How to Stop Overthinking](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-stop-overthinking-5186952): Strategies for interrupting rumination and repetitive thoughts.
- [What Is Resilience?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-resilience-2795059): Overview of resilience and ways to strengthen it.

## Relationships and Social Behavior
- [Social Exchange Theory](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-social-exchange-theory-2795882): Explains cost-benefit thinking and reciprocity in relationships.
- [Attachment Styles](https://www.verywellmind.com/attachment-styles-2795344): Overview of secure, anxious, avoidant, and disorganized attachment.
- [Weaponized Incompetence](https://www.verywellmind.com/weaponized-incompetence-7553422): Describes the behavior and its impact on relationships.
- [What Is Gaslighting?](https://www.verywellmind.com/is-someone-gaslighting-you-4147470): Signs, examples, and effects of gaslighting behavior.
- [Codependency](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-codependency-5072124): Defines codependency and common relationship patterns.
- [What Is Active Listening?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-active-listening-3024343): Communication skill guide for better understanding and connection.
- [What Is Empathy?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-empathy-2795562): Explains empathy, types, and interpersonal importance.
- [How to Deal With a Narcissist](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-deal-with-a-narcissist-5214552): Boundary-setting and coping strategies for difficult interactions.

## Psychology Concepts and Theories
- [Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-maslows-hierarchy-of-needs-4136760): Summary of Maslow's motivational theory and need levels.
- [Classical Conditioning](https://www.verywellmind.com/classical-conditioning-2794859): Explains associative learning and key conditioning concepts.
- [Operant Conditioning](https://www.verywellmind.com/operant-conditioning-a2-2794863): Overview of reinforcement, punishment, and behavior shaping.
- [The Id, Ego, and Superego](https://www.verywellmind.com/the-id-ego-and-superego-2795951): Freud's structural model of personality explained.
- [Theories of Intelligence](https://www.verywellmind.com/theories-of-intelligence-2795035): Reviews major models of intelligence in psychology.
- [Carol Gilligan's Theory of Moral Development](https://www.verywellmind.com/the-carol-gilligan-theory-and-a-woman-s-sense-of-self-5198408): Explains Gilligan's perspective on moral reasoning and care.
- [What Is Confirmation Bias?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-a-confirmation-bias-2795024): Defines confirmation bias and its effects on judgment.
- [What Is Cognitive Dissonance?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-cognitive-dissonance-2795012): Explains mental discomfort from conflicting beliefs and actions.

## Stress, Wellness, and Daily Living
- [Stress Management](https://www.verywellmind.com/stress-management-4157211): Collection of articles on coping with stress and overwhelm.
- [Meditation](https://www.verywellmind.com/meditation-4157215): Guides to meditation practices and mental health benefits.
- [Sleep and Dreaming](https://www.verywellmind.com/sleep-and-dreaming-4157216): Articles on sleep habits, dreams, and mental wellbeing.
- [Mindfulness](https://www.verywellmind.com/mindfulness-4157095): Mindfulness techniques for focus, calm, and emotional regulation.
- [Breathing Exercises for Anxiety](https://www.verywellmind.com/breathing-exercises-for-anxiety-5184735): Simple breathing methods to reduce acute anxiety symptoms.
- [How to Relieve Stress](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-relieve-stress-3145195): Practical stress reduction techniques for everyday situations.
- [How to Sleep Better](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-sleep-better-5094121): Tips for improving sleep quality and bedtime routines.
- [What Are Depression Naps?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-are-depression-naps-5094065): Discusses excessive sleeping linked to depression and fatigue.

## Addiction and Recovery
- [Addiction](https://www.verywellmind.com/addiction-4157288): Hub for substance use, behavioral addiction, and recovery topics.
- [Alcohol Use](https://www.verywellmind.com/alcohol-use-4157289): Articles on drinking behavior, dependence, and recovery support.
- [Smoking and Nicotine Use](https://www.verywellmind.com/smoking-and-nicotine-use-4157290): Resources on nicotine dependence, quitting, and withdrawal.
- [Coping With Withdrawal](https://www.verywellmind.com/coping-with-withdrawal-22390): Guidance on withdrawal symptoms and recovery challenges.
- [The Stages of Change Model](https://www.verywellmind.com/the-stages-of-change-model-of-overcoming-addiction-21961): Transtheoretical model for behavior change and addiction recovery.
- [What Is Harm Reduction?](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-harm-reduction-5120402): Overview of harm reduction principles and practical strategies.
- [Nicotine Withdrawal](https://www.verywellmind.com/nicotine-withdrawal-2824388): Symptoms, timeline, and coping methods for nicotine withdrawal.
- [How to Quit Smoking](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-to-quit-smoking-2824748): Evidence-based approaches for smoking cessation.
